title: Consider the Impact of a Larger Sample Size
text: Think about how increasing the sample size from $$100$$ to $$200$$ might affect the selection bias. Would it make the sample more representative of the entire population?

title: Effect of Reminder Emails
text: Consider how sending a reminder email to non-respondents might influence the selection bias. Would it encourage more students to respond, potentially reducing bias?

title: Analyzing the Impact of Both Changes
text: If Josh implements both changes, how would the combination of a larger sample size and reminder emails affect the selection bias compared to the original survey?

title: Understanding Selection Bias
text: Selection bias occurs when certain groups are overrepresented or underrepresented in a sample. How might the changes suggested by Jake address this issue?
